subject.character: ONE garden snail, grey-olive body, clear face, eyes on long stalks, small mouth; brown shell with a heavy brass padlock, chain taut from it into depth; same face and colour throughout
subject.anti_action: the world dives at him; weary serious face, brisk dry talker

second_characters: ONE magpie; ONE small shell-less hermit crab, smaller than the snail's shell
props: padlock: smooth brass, no engraving; disc: smooth gold, no engraving
environment: wet stone garden step after rain, early morning; dense background: wet leaves, moss, drops, clay pots
lighting: low sun behind-left edges stalks and wet shell, bright sky glow edges him from behind-right, warm glints on brass and gold, high contrast, bright
motion_rule: The world flies at him: magpie, crab, disc and chain move along the depth axis into the lens, every beat. He twists, stretches and crawls every beat. New shot size and a short push or tilt every beat, never on a schedule.

audio.delivery: flat low brisk male voice, native, no accent; first word on frame one; stress VYgodny on first syllable
audio.pacing: brisk, each line once, inside its beat, no speech after 6.4

timeline.a: mouth opens on every syllable; first frame: extreme close-up, stalks at the lens, padlocked shell, chain taut into depth; he creeps up the step edge; the magpie dives from depth at the lens
mouth opens on every syllable; low angle, chest-up; he stretches his neck, then lowers both eyes; the magpie hovers at the lens, drops a gold disc, it bounces twice on the stone, rim flashes
mouth opens on every syllable; full figure, three-quarter; he creeps onto the disc, it slides under the shell rim, one gold edge shows
low angle from behind, padlock in front; shell sinks, body flattens, stalks droop; chain jerks taut from depth, padlock clanks
mouth opens on every syllable; close-up, chain into blurred depth; he turns his stalks back along it; the chain whips taut toward the lens; down it a hermit crab seizes it
mouth opens on every syllable; chain-level, over his shoulder; the snail jabs a stalk at the crab; the crab runs up the chain at the lens
mouth opens on every syllable; extreme close-up; he bends both stalks onto his own chest; at the lens edge the crab rubs both claws, eyeing the shell, not touching him
medium shot from below; the snail springs up bare, unharmed, stalks shooting up, as the crab lifts the shell off by the padlock in one jerk, like a lid; sun flares on his wet body
close-up, shell soft behind; he twists round, stalks lagging; at his shoulder the crab backs into the shell, padlock clicks
macro at stone level; he sweeps both stalks down; the magpie dives at the lens, snatches the gold disc rolling from the shell mouth; crab hidden inside
extreme close-up, bare snail, same face and colour as the start; he stretches his bare body at the lens, one stalk droops, gaze in the lens; behind, a claw waves from the locked shell

must_appear: 0.00 padlock and chain on shell; 6.30 crab lifts shell off; 7.20 crab in shell; final: bare snail faces lens
